hard_nonclaims: F-VQ34 does not select, recommend or qualify a numeric H_budget for any application.
F-VQ34 does not establish a universal temporal tolerance or default H_budget.
F-VQ34 does not establish B_inf as a nonlinear true-error upper bound.
F-VQ34 does not establish that shorter dt monotonically reduces C_h.
F-VQ34 does not qualify initial no-history bootstrap or arbitrary restart/forcing/event/topology-discontinuity continuation beyond already-qualified provenance.
F-VQ34 does not release F-GC02, groundwater coupling, performance policy or any other downstream workstream by itself.
The failed F-VQ33 result remains failed and is not reused as positive evidence.

downstream_handoff.remaining_policy_dependency: Application/runtime provenance must supply an explicit finite positive H_budget; F-VQ34 provides no numeric selection rule.
downstream_handoff.continuation_dependency: No-history and other unqualified continuation boundaries remain fail-closed unless separately qualified.
